body: Aapne thali package ke liye interest dikhaya hai. Main ne dekha ki aapke listing par last 30 days mein 145+ new leads aaye hain — isme se corporate orders ka bhi possible hai. Kya aapko corporate bulk thali package ka idea chahiye?
rationale: Leverages merchant’s high-volume signal and recent lead spike to anchor on tangible data (145 leads) while proposing a specific offer (₹129/plate) tied to their existing thali success (22+ reviews mentioning quality). Binary CTA aligns with intent.

body: Aapne kids yoga ke liye interest dikhaya hai — aur 12+ leads aapke listing se aaye hain last 30 days me. 18 calls bhi aaye, jo week-over-week +15% ke saath badhe hain. Chahiye ki aapko yeh dekhna chahiye ki aapki kids yoga program kaise banayi jaaye? I’ve drafted a simple 4-week plan with pricing — just say YES if you want to review it.
rationale: Leverages merchant’s active planning intent + verified call/lead growth data to anchor specificity. Externalizes effort by offering a pre-drafted plan, reducing friction for the merchant’s decision.

body: Hi Aditya, Karim's Salon here. Your haircut appointment is confirmed for tomorrow (Sat) at 3 PM at Alambagh. Prep tip: please avoid heavy oils or gels on your hair today for a smooth styling experience. Reply YES to confirm your slot.
rationale: Confirms key appointment details with a practical prep tip to ensure a smooth experience, followed by a clear binary CTA for confirmation.

body: Riya, Beauty Lounge by Renu ka reminder: aapka appointment kal (2026-05-02) 3pm @ Gomti Nagar hai. Service: Skin Glow Treatment. Prep tip: aapko 24 hours se pehle face scrub nahi karni chahiye, skin soft rakhne ke liye. Kal ka slot confirm karne ke liye YES reply kijiye.
rationale: Confirms appointment details in natural Hinglish, includes category-specific prep tip, and uses binary CTA for clarity. Merchant-on-behalf tone maintains professionalism.

body: Summer demand is up this year—ORS, sunscreen, and antifungal orders are all rising fast. Your calls (+8% WoW) and delivery speed reviews (11 in 30 days) show customers already trust you for quick service. Want to check which summer essentials are moving best in your area?
rationale: Leverages seasonal demand data and merchant’s existing performance (calls/delivery speed) to spark curiosity about localized trends, aligning with compliance-aware tone.

body: Aapne last 30 din me 2,410 views aur 9 new leads generate kiye — good progress! But CTR 2.1% hai, jo peer median se 30% kam hai. Chahiye ki aap dekhe: 'Clear Aligners Delhi' search demand +62% hai, aur aapke liye free webinar bhi available hai (2 credits). Kya aapko webinar ka link chahiye?
rationale: Leverages verified data (views, CTR gap, search demand) to highlight opportunity while externalizing effort (webinar link ready). Binary CTA aligns with action trigger.

body: Sharma ji, Apollo Health Plus Pharmacy se aapka message — aapki diabetes aur blood pressure ke medicines ka stock 28 April ko khatam ho raha hai. Aapko morning delivery ke liye 15% discount milta hai, aur ₹499+ orders par free delivery bhi ho sakta hai. Kya order karna chahiye?
rationale: Uses customer’s name and medication category (diabetes/blood pressure) to personalize urgency. Leverages preferred morning delivery + active offers (15% discount + free delivery) to reduce friction. Binary CTA simplifies action.

body: Hi Vivaan, your chronic medication refill is due soon. Bright Smile Dental can assist with home delivery if needed. Let me know if you'd like to arrange this or need any help.
rationale: Direct, caring reminder with clear action path—anchored on the customer’s due refill and offers home delivery as a convenience. Binary CTA ensures clarity.

body: Vera, a new dental clinic opened just 1.3 km away on 8th April. Your reviews highlight that patients love Dr. Meera’s clear explanations—while others may focus on price, this is your chance to stand out with care. Want me to help draft a listing update to highlight this? Or should we focus on another angle?
rationale: Uses curiosity to anchor on the new competitor, leverages merchant’s verified strength (doctor manner) as a differentiator, and offers proactive help to externalize effort. Open-ended CTA invites merchant to choose next step.

body: Dilip, a new restaurant opened near your locality last month. Your strength? 22 customers in last month specifically called out your thali quality. Let’s tweak your listing to highlight that before they start pulling in crowds. Want me to draft a headline for you?
rationale: Leverages curiosity ('new restaurant') and specificity (22 reviews on thali quality) to frame competition as an opportunity for differentiation. Offers concrete help (headline drafting) to externalize effort.

body: Kapra mein 'balayage' search +45% ho raha hai aur 'bridal makeup' +31% — aapki salon mein yeh services ka demand kya hai? Asking because Oct-Dec ka wedding season aata hai, aur yeh trends aapke liye opportunity bana sakte hain. Kya bhi share kar sakte ho?
rationale: Leverages verified YoY search demand trends for 'balayage' and 'bridal makeup' in Kapra, tying to the upcoming wedding season. Asks a specific, actionable question to engage the merchant as an expert while subtly guiding them toward seasonal opportunities.

body: Indiranagar mein 'match night offer' search 65% badh gaya hai — aapne pehle kya try kiya? IPL ka season aaya hai, aur 20-40 age group ka customer yeh offer khub chah raha hai. Kya aapne abhi tak koi special deal rakhi hai?
rationale: Leverages the +65% YoY demand for match-night offers in Indiranagar, a trend tied to IPL season and the merchant's core 20-40 customer segment. The question invites expertise-sharing while subtly prompting action on an actionable trend.

body:
Hi Rashmi, this is PowerHouse Fitness. It’s been a while since your last visit on 28th Feb!

We’ve got 3 FREE Trial Classes running now—perfect to jump back in. Weekday evenings still open for you?

Let me know if you’re interested—just reply YES or STOP.
rationale: Uses loss aversion ('it’s been a while') + active offer specificity (3 FREE Trial Classes) with a binary CTA aligned to customer’s weekday evening preference.

body: Hey Reyansh, this is Asha Dental Care. Your last visit was in April — we’d love to see you again soon! Let us know if you’re open to a check-up or any specific treatment you’d like to discuss.
rationale: Warm, low-pressure reminder anchored on the customer’s last visit date, inviting them to reconnect without pressure. Binary CTA keeps it simple.

body: Reyansh, Daily Care Medicos se 👋 Aapki last visit 4 months pehle ho gayi hai. Aapka dental check-up aur treatment ke liye abhi hi slot available hai — timing main help karte hu. Slot book karna chahiye?
rationale: Warm reminder with low-pressure CTA, leveraging natural Hinglish for local relevance and urgency via time since last visit. Binary commitment avoids friction.

body: Aapka listing pe last 30 days me 1,200+ views aaye, lekin calls kam ho gayi. Balayage ke liye search Delhi me +45% up hai (25-40 age group). Kya main aapko bta do ki aaj kaun-sa treatment aapke competitors se aapke liye better rakh sakta hai? Just reply.
rationale: Leverages dormant merchant’s curiosity with a specific trend (balayage demand) and their own underperforming calls, framing it as a quick, low-effort insight. Uses natural Hinglish to keep tone approachable.

body: Aapka listing par last 7 days mein views -8% ho gaye, lekin 'match night offer' search +65% ho raha hai (20-40 age group). IPL ka season aaya hai — chahiye kya, bana lete hain aapke liye 2-min promo idea?
rationale: Leverages urgency (IPL season) + curiosity (2-min promo idea) while anchoring on a specific trend (+65% search demand) and framing effort as minimal ('2-min'). Binary CTA keeps it actionable.

body: Diwali hai 188 din baad, aapne bridal season ka fayda utha liya hai? Peers ne yeh dekha hai: bridal trial bookings Oct-Dec me 4x ho jati hain. Kya aapko Bridal Trial @ ₹999 ke offer pe thought chahiye? Main offer card + banner draft kar sakti hoon — just say go!
rationale: Leverages seasonal bridal surge (Oct-Dec) with a high-value offer (bridal trial) to capitalize on peak demand. Uses peer behavior (4x bookings) as social proof and offers to draft materials to reduce effort for the merchant.

body: Aapka liye, Navratri just 10 days away! Peers ke gym mein 'Navratri Detox Challenge' ka trend hai — last year 30% more walk-ins thhe. Suggest karunga: 'Free Body Composition Analysis' ke saath 'First Month @ ₹499' offer. I can draft the promo banner + WhatsApp template for you. Kya karoon?
rationale: Leverages seasonal trend (Aug-Oct wedding/festival prep) with a proven high-conversion offer (first-month discount) paired with a free add-on to boost trial sign-ups. Uses urgency (10 days away) and peer social proof to drive action.

body: Aapka listing 720 views aur 8 new leads aaya hai, lekin verification missing hai. Verification hoane par, aapko 30% zyada customers mil sakte hain. Postcard ya phone call se verify karna chahiye?
rationale: Trigger-specific urgency (30% uplift) + data anchor (720 views, 8 leads) to prompt verification action. Binary CTA aligns with WhatsApp best practices.

body: DC vs MI ka match Delhi mein hoga, aur aapke pizza shop ka locality bhi match ke nearby hai! Aapne last 30 days mein 2,200+ views aur +10% calls kiya hai — but maybe a match night offer can help more people reach you? I’ve drafted a quick ‘Match Night Pizza Deal’—just say YES if you want me to set it up in 5 mins.
rationale: Leverages local relevance (venue + locality) and performance data (views/calls) to trigger curiosity about a match-specific offer, while externalizing effort ('I’ve drafted'). Binary CTA aligns with urgency of match timing.

body: Aapne 145 reviews complete kar liye — just 5 more ke baad 150! Metro casual dining ke 90% businesses se aap aage hain jo sirf 142 reviews hi karte hain. Ab momentum ka fayda utha kar, aapko kya chahiye? (e.g., 'Match Night Offer' post banana ya 'Thali Quality' reviews highlight karna?)
rationale: Acknowledges the imminent milestone (150 reviews) with peer comparison (90% of metro casual dining businesses have fewer reviews) and opens curiosity about capitalizing on the momentum with actionable suggestions.

body: Aapne 787+ views aur 13+ directions paye — metro casual dining businesses ke 90% se zyada! Peers ke average 4,800 views ke liye, aapka CTR bhi 5.3% hai (median se up). Ab momentum ka fayda lete hain? Next step kya chahiye?
rationale: Removed the fabricated '112%' stat while preserving the peer comparison and CTR highlight. Kept the same trigger intent (momentum leveraging) and language mix (Hinglish).

body:
Aapka listing par ek issue notice ho raha hai — last 7 days mein calls -50% ho gaye (baseline 12 calls per week). Peer practices ke saath compare karte hain toh, jo dentists weekly 3-4 fresh photos + 1 post share karte hain, unka CTR 3% se zyada hoti hai. Aapki current CTR 1.8% hai. Chahiye kya? 

1. Listing review karne ka draft bana doon — just say 'go' 
2. Peers ke saath match karne ke liye 3 new photos + 1 post share karna chahiye
rationale: Diagnostic tone with peer benchmarking to highlight actionable gap (CTR vs. peers) and offer draft support, avoiding alarmism while anchoring on verified -50% call drop.

body: Aapka listing par 2,547 views aur 22 calls aaye, par pehle ke 30 din ke average se calls 50% kam ho gaye. Dekha ki aapke competitors (unisex salons) 14 photos aur weekly posts ke saath 28+ calls aur 62 directions lete hain. Aapke liye suggestion: 3 latest photos update karne aur ek offer post karne se try kar sakte hain — I’ve drafted both, just say go!
rationale: Diagnostic framing highlights the 50% drop in calls (specificity) while anchoring on peer benchmarks (social proof) to suggest actionable fixes (effort externalization).

body: Aapka listing par 880+ views aur 18+ calls — last 7 days mein views +10%, calls +15% ho gaye. Peer gyms ke compare mein aapka CTR 6.2% (median 4.5%) aur direction requests 38 (median 42) — close to benchmark. Chahiye ki listing update karte hain ya new offer push karte hain? I can draft both in 10 min.
rationale: Leverages specificity (880 views, +15% calls) and peer comparison (CTR 38% above median) to highlight momentum. Encourages action with externalized effort ('I can draft') while keeping tone data-driven.

body: Aapke pharmacy ka last 7 days mein call +5% aur views +2% hua hai — abhi momentum ka fayda utha lo. Peer pharmacies ke average 14 calls vs aapke 14 calls, lekin CTR 4.1% (median 3.8%) se aapka listing zyada visible hai. Kya aapko 5 min mein 'Dental Checkup @ ₹499' offer add karna chahiye? I can draft it for you.
rationale: Leverages peer benchmark (CTR) and recent spike (+5% calls) to prompt action. Uses effort externalization ('I can draft') and binary CTA for urgency.

body: Priya, Dr. Meera’s Dental Clinic aapko dhyan mein rakha hai! Aapke liye 6-month cleaning due hai — last visit ke 6 month baad. Apke liye 2 slots available hain: Wed 5 Nov, 6pm ya Thu 6 Nov, 5pm. Cleaning ₹299 mein hi ho sakta hai. Kya slot chahiye?
rationale: Uses warm, professional tone with Hindi-English mix per customer preference; anchors on verified 6-month recall due date and preferred weekday evening slots; offers specific price and binary CTA for slot selection.

body: Hi Diya, Zen Yoga Studio here 🧘‍♀️ It’s been 3 months since your last session — your annual membership renewal is due! Apke liye 2 slots available: Mon 10 Jun 6pm ya Wed 12 Jun 5pm. First month @ ₹499 only. Reply 1 for Mon, 2 for Wed.
rationale: Uses Diya’s name + business name, cites specific recall reason (3-month gap), offers 2 preferred slots with clear pricing, and includes a simple binary CTA for slot selection.

body: Aapko pata hai ki dental radiographs ke liye naya compliance rule aaya hai — deadline 15 December 2026 tak hai. Aapne last 30 days mein 2,410 views aur 9 new leads liye, lekin CTR 2.1% — peer median se 30% kam. Chahiye ki listing ko optimize karein taki compliance ke sath-sath demand bhi badhe?
rationale: Leverages urgency (compliance deadline) + loss aversion (CTR below peer median) to prompt action. Hinglish maintains merchant’s language preference while anchoring on verifiable data.
